Reprocesses the long-term epithelial arm and transfers labels from the short-term object.

Paths are relative to this `scripts/` directory.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load Packages
```{r chunk-01}
pacman::p_load("dplyr", "Seurat", "glue", "ggplot2", "harmony", "presto")
```

# Load Data
```{r chunk-02}
seu_obj_epi_short_term <- readRDS("../outputs/short-term_seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed.RDS")
seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22 <- readRDS("../../01-separate-epithelia-immune/outputs/long-term-2024-03-22_seu-obj-long-term-epithelia-2024-03-22-RNA-RNA_snn_res.0.5.RDS")

# Split based on orig.ident (seq run) for Harmony
# Join Layers (to then split)
seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22 <- JoinLayers(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22)

# Resplit Layers
seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22[["RNA"]] <- split(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22[["RNA"]],
                                              f = seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22$orig.ident)

# Verify that layers are as I expect
Layers(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22)
```

# Reprocess Pipeline
```{r chunk-03}
multi_sample_pipeline <- function(merged_seu_obj, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA") {
  
  if (res_cols == "SCT") {
    merged_seu_obj <- SCTransform(merged_seu_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  } else {
    merged_seu_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- ScaleData(merged_seu_obj)
  }
  
  merged_seu_obj <- RunPCA(merged_seu_obj)
  # Harmony's k-means initialisation is stochastic and carries no default seed,
  # unlike RunUMAP (seed.use = 42) and FindClusters (random.seed = 0).
  set.seed(42)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunHarmony(merged_seu_obj, assay.use = res_cols, group.by.vars = split_col)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunUMAP(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindNeighbors(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindClusters(merged_seu_obj, resolution = c(1:10 / 10))
  
  return(merged_seu_obj)
}
```

## Run Pipeline
```{r chunk-04}
seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed <- multi_sample_pipeline(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA")

# Add ribo genes just in case
ribo_genes_mouse <- grep("^Rpl|^Rps", rownames(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed), value = TRUE)
seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed, features = ribo_genes_mouse)

# View UMAP
DimPlot(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1")
```

######## TRANSFER LABELS #########
#Combined Analysis to Transfer Labels
## b . Function
```{r chunk-05}
transfer_labels_function <- function(seu_obj_labeled, seu_obj_unlabeled) {
  
  # 1. Merge Seurat Objects
  merged_seu_obj <- merge(seu_obj_labeled, seu_obj_unlabeled)
  
  DefaultAssay(merged_seu_obj) <- "RNA"
  merged_seu_obj <- JoinLayers(merged_seu_obj)
  
  # 2. Remove Old RNA Columns
  merged_seu_obj@meta.data <- merged_seu_obj@meta.data %>%
    select(-starts_with("RNA_snn"), -seurat_clusters)
  
  # 3. Run Pipeline
  merged_seu_obj <- multi_sample_pipeline(merged_seu_obj, split_col = "orig.ident")
  
  # 4. Transfer Labels
  seu_obj.ref <- subset(merged_seu_obj, Time_Course %in% c("short_term"))
  seu_obj.query <- subset(merged_seu_obj, Time_Course %in% c("long_term"))
  
  seu_obj.ref <- NormalizeData(seu_obj.ref)
  seu_obj.query <- NormalizeData(seu_obj.query)
  
  seu_obj.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = seu_obj.ref, query = seu_obj.query, dims = 1:40, reference.reduction = "pca")
  predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = seu_obj.anchors, refdata = seu_obj.ref$cell_type_broad, dims = 1:40)
  seu_obj.query <- AddMetaData(seu_obj.query, metadata = predictions)
  
  return(seu_obj.query)
}

# Run Transfer Labels
seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_transfer_labels <- transfer_labels_function(seu_obj_epi_short_term, seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed)

seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed$predicted_transfer_label <- seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_transfer_labels$predicted.id
```

```{r chunk-08}
# Onur Feature Plots
onur_markers_path <- "../data/Onur_Markers.xlsx"

onur_markers_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(onur_markers_path, sheet = "Non-Immune")
onur_markers_list <- as.list(onur_markers_df)

for (cell_type in names(onur_markers_list)) {
  
  marker_list <- na.omit(onur_markers_list[[cell_type]])
  pdf(glue("../outputs/long-term_{cell_type}-Feature-Plots.pdf"), height = 10, width = 12)
  for (gene in marker_list) {
    gene_trim <- trimws(gene)
    
    tryCatch({
      # Try to plot the feature
      Seurat::FeaturePlot(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_transfer_labels, features = gene_trim) %>% print()
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Handle the error
      message(glue("Error: {e$message} for gene {gene_trim}"))
    })
  }
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

for (celltype in names(genes.of.interest)) {
  plots <- lapply(genes.of.interest[[celltype]], function(gene) {
    FeaturePlot(seu_obj_epi_long_term_2024_03_22_processed, features = gene) + ggtitle(gene)
  })
  
  plot <- wrap_plots(plots) +  
    plot_annotation(
      title = celltype,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20))
    )
  
  # Print Plot
  print(plot)
  
  # Save Plot
  pdf(glue("../outputs/long-term_{celltype}-FeaturePlots.pdf"), height = 8, width = 12)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}
```
